balance-of-payments.def: The record of every transaction between a country's residents and the rest of the world over a period, such as a year. It has two parts, the current account and the capital and financial account, which sum to zero.

current-account.def: The part of the balance of payments that records the balance of trade in goods and services, net income from abroad (interest, dividends, wages) and net transfers. A negative balance is a current account deficit.

financial-account.def: The part of the balance of payments that records purchases and sales of assets, such as bonds, stocks, real estate and firms. A foreign purchase of a domestic asset is a credit; a resident's purchase of a foreign asset is a debit.

balance-of-trade.def: Exports of goods and services minus imports of goods and services: net exports. It is the largest part of the current account; a negative balance is a trade deficit.
